query.name: org.bps.sbgassign.standardscore.sbgassignscore
query.description: Assignments by studentdcid, standardid, and sectiondcid
query.sql:
select s.dcid "StudentDCID" ,s.id "StudentID" ,s_sm.SECTIONSDCID "SectionsDCID" , st.standardid "StandardID" , psm_sa.dateassignmentdue "DueDate" , psm_sa.id "AssignmentID" ,to_char(psm_sa.DATEASSIGNMENTDUE,'MM/DD/YYYY') "DueDateTxt" ,st.identifier "Identifier" ,psm_ac.Name "Category" ,psm_a.name "AssignmentName" ,psm_a.description "Description" ,psm_ascore.ACTUALSCOREENTERED "AssignmentScore" , t.YEARID "Yearid" , psm_ascore.turnedin "Collected" , psm_ascore.exempt "StandardExempt"
from psm_reportcarditem psm_rci inner join PSM_REPORTCARDITEMGRADE psm_rcig on psm_rci.id = psm_rcig.REPORTCARDITEMID inner join PSM_REPORTINGTERM psm_rt on psm_rci.REPORTINGTERMID = psm_rt.id inner join sync_termmap sync_t on psm_rt.TERMID = sync_t.termid inner join terms t on sync_t.termsdcid = t.dcid inner join sync_sectionenrollmentmap s_sem on s_sem.sectionenrollmentid = psm_rcig.SECTIONENROLLMENTID inner join cc on s_sem.ccdcid = cc.dcid inner join students s on cc.studentid = s.id inner join psm_standard psm_st on psm_st.id = psm_rci.STANDARDID inner join sync_standardmap sstm on sstm.standardid = psm_st.ID inner join standard st on sstm.STANDARDSDCID = st.LONGITUDINALID inner join sync_sectionmap s_sm on s_sm.sectionid = psm_rci.SECTIONID inner join psm_assignmentstandard psm_as on psm_as.standardid = psm_rci.standardid inner join psm_assignmentstandardscore psm_ascore on psm_ascore.assignmentstandardid = psm_as.id and psm_ascore.sectionenrollmentid = psm_rcig.sectionenrollmentid inner join PSM_SECTIONASSIGNMENT psm_sa on psm_as.SECTIONASSIGNMENTID = psm_sa.ID inner join PSM_ASSIGNMENT psm_a on psm_sa.ASSIGNMENTID = psm_a.ID inner join PSM_ASSIGNMENTCATEGORY psm_ac on psm_a.ASSIGNMENTCATEGORYID = psm_ac.id where s.id = :curstudid
union
select s.dcid ,s.id ,ase.SECTIONSDCID , st.standardid , ase.duedate , ase.assignmentsectionid ,to_char(ase.DUEDATE,'MM/DD/YYYY') "DueDate" ,st.identifier ,nvl(tc.NAME, dtc.name) "Category" ,ase.name "AssignName" ,ase.DESCRIPTION "Description" ,ss.ACTUALSCOREENTERED "StandardScore" , t.YEARID "YearID" , ss.iscollected , case when asa.ISCOUNTEDINSTANDARDGRADE = 0 or ss.isexempt = 1 then 1 else 0 end
from standardscore ss inner join students s on ss.STUDENTSDCID = s.DCID inner join assignmentsection ase on ss.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID = ase.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID inner join assignmentstandardassoc asa on ss.ASSIGNMENTSTANDARDASSOCID = asa.ASSIGNMENTSTANDARDASSOCID inner join standard st on asa.STANDARDID = st.STANDARDID inner join ASSIGNMENTCATEGORYASSOC aca on aca.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID = ase.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID inner join Assignment asg on ase.ASSIGNMENTID = asg.ASSIGNMENTID inner join TEACHERCATEGORY tc on tc.TEACHERCATEGORYID = aca.TEACHERCATEGORYID inner join sections se on ase.SECTIONSDCID = se.dcid inner join terms t on se.termid = t.ID and se.schoolid = t.SCHOOLID left join districtteachercategory dtc on tc.DISTRICTTEACHERCATEGORYID = dtc.districtteachercategoryid
where s.id = :curstudid order by 3,4,5 desc

query.name: org.bps.sbgassign.sections.calcmethod
query.description: Assignments by studentdcid, standardid, and sectiondcid
query.sql:
select s.dcid "StudentsDCID" , s.id "StudentID" ,se.dcid "SectionsDCID" ,psm_ssc.RECENCYSETUP "Weight" ,case psm_ssc.calculationtype when 0 then 'Average' when 1 then 'Median' when 2 then 'Mode' when 3 then 'Highest' when 4 then 'Most Recent' when 5 then 'None' end "CalcMethod" ,psm_rt.NAME "Term" ,psm_rt.startdate "TermStart" ,psm_rt.ENDDATE "TermEnd"
from students s inner join cc on s.id = cc.studentid inner join sections se on cc.SECTIONID = se.ID inner join sync_sectionmap s_sm on s_sm.SECTIONSDCID = se.DCID inner join psm_sectionstandardcalc psm_ssc on s_sm.SECTIONID = psm_ssc.SECTIONID inner join psm_reportingterm psm_rt on psm_rt.id = psm_ssc.REPORTINGTERMID where s.id = :curstudid
union
select s.dcid , s.id , se.dcid , nvl(gse.RECENTSCOREWEIGHTLIST, gsc.RECENTSCOREWEIGHTLIST) , replace(nvl(gse.STNDCALCULATIONMETRIC, gsc.CALCULATIONMETRIC), '_', ' ') , nvl(gct.storecode, tb.STORECODE) , nvl(tbsc.date1, tb.date1) , nvl(tbsc.date2, tb.date2) from students s inner join cc on s.id = cc.STUDENTID inner join sections se on cc.SECTIONID = se.id inner join terms t on se.TERMID = t.id and se.SCHOOLID = t.SCHOOLID inner join schools sc on sc.SCHOOL_NUMBER = se.SCHOOLID left join gradesectionconfig gse on gse.SECTIONSDCID = se.DCID left join GRADESCHOOLCONFIG gsc on gsc.SCHOOLSDCID = sc.DCID left join gradeformulaset gfs on gfs.SECTIONSDCID = se.DCID and gfs.YEARID = t.YEARID left join GRADECALCULATIONTYPE gct on gct.GRADEFORMULASETID = gfs.GRADEFORMULASETID and gct.YEARID = gfs.YEARID left join termbins tb on se.SCHOOLID = tb.SCHOOLID and t.YEARID = tb.YEARID and tb.termid = tb.yearid * 100 left join termbins tbsc on se.SCHOOLID = tbsc.SCHOOLID and t.YEARID = tbsc.YEARID and tb.termid = tbsc.yearid * 100 and gct.STORECODE = tb.STORECODE
where s.id = :curstudid order by 2,5

query.name: org.bps.sbgassign.standardscore.sbgassignscoretrend
query.description: Score trend by studentdcid, standardid, and sectiondcid
query.sql:
with assignDetail as( select s.dcid StudentDCID ,s.id StudentID ,s_sm.SECTIONSDCID SectionsDCID , st.standardid StandardID , psm_sa.dateassignmentdue DueDate ,psm_ascore.ACTUALSCOREENTERED AssignmentScore , psm_ascore.score ConvertedScore , t.YEARID Yearid , psm_ascore.exempt StandardExempt from psm_reportcarditem psm_rci inner join PSM_REPORTCARDITEMGRADE psm_rcig on psm_rci.id = psm_rcig.REPORTCARDITEMID inner join PSM_REPORTINGTERM psm_rt on psm_rci.REPORTINGTERMID = psm_rt.id inner join sync_termmap sync_t on psm_rt.TERMID = sync_t.termid inner join terms t on sync_t.termsdcid = t.dcid inner join sync_sectionenrollmentmap s_sem on s_sem.sectionenrollmentid = psm_rcig.SECTIONENROLLMENTID inner join cc on s_sem.ccdcid = cc.dcid inner join students s on cc.studentid = s.id inner join psm_standard psm_st on psm_st.id = psm_rci.STANDARDID inner join sync_standardmap sstm on sstm.standardid = psm_st.ID inner join standard st on sstm.STANDARDSDCID = st.LONGITUDINALID and st.yearid = t.yearid inner join sync_sectionmap s_sm on s_sm.sectionid = psm_rci.SECTIONID inner join psm_assignmentstandard psm_as on psm_as.standardid = psm_rci.standardid inner join psm_assignmentstandardscore psm_ascore on psm_ascore.assignmentstandardid = psm_as.id and psm_ascore.sectionenrollmentid = psm_rcig.sectionenrollmentid inner join PSM_SECTIONASSIGNMENT psm_sa on psm_as.SECTIONASSIGNMENTID = psm_sa.ID inner join PSM_ASSIGNMENT psm_a on psm_sa.ASSIGNMENTID = psm_a.ID inner join PSM_ASSIGNMENTCATEGORY psm_ac on psm_a.ASSIGNMENTCATEGORYID = psm_ac.id where s.id = :curstudid
union
select s.dcid ,s.id ,ase.SECTIONSDCID , st.standardid , ase.duedate ,ss.ACTUALSCOREENTERED , ss.ScorePercent , t.YEARID , case when asa.ISCOUNTEDINSTANDARDGRADE = 0 or ss.isexempt = 1 then 1 else 0 end from standardscore ss inner join students s on ss.STUDENTSDCID = s.DCID inner join assignmentsection ase on ss.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID = ase.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID inner join assignmentstandardassoc asa on ss.ASSIGNMENTSTANDARDASSOCID = asa.ASSIGNMENTSTANDARDASSOCID inner join standard st on asa.STANDARDID = st.STANDARDID inner join ASSIGNMENTCATEGORYASSOC aca on aca.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID = ase.ASSIGNMENTSECTIONID inner join Assignment asg on ase.ASSIGNMENTID = asg.ASSIGNMENTID inner join TEACHERCATEGORY tc on tc.TEACHERCATEGORYID = aca.TEACHERCATEGORYID inner join sections se on ase.SECTIONSDCID = se.dcid inner join terms t on se.termid = t.ID and se.schoolid = t.SCHOOLID
where s.id = :curstudid ), scoreByN as( select StudentDCID , StudentID , SectionsDCID , StandardID , YearID , DueDate , row_number() over (partition by YearID, StudentDCID, SectionsDCID, StandardID order by YearID, StudentDCID, SectionsDCID, StandardID, DueDate) as rNumber , case when LENGTH(TRIM(TRANSLATE(AssignmentScore, ' +-.0123456789', ' '))) is null then AssignmentScore else to_char(ConvertedScore) end AssignmentScore -- use the assignment score if it looks like a number, otherwise use the converted score (Grade Value from Grade Scale) , StandardExempt from assignDetail where AssignmentScore is not null and (LENGTH(TRIM(TRANSLATE(AssignmentScore, ' +-.0123456789', ' '))) is null or (LENGTH(TRIM(TRANSLATE(AssignmentScore, ' +-.0123456789', ' '))) is not null and ConvertedScore is not null) ) ), slopeAll as( select StudentDCID , StudentID , SectionsDCID , StandardID , YearID , count(DueDate) scoreCount , sum(StandardExempt) exemptCount , case when count(DueDate) > 1 then round(regr_slope(AssignmentScore, rNumber), 1) else 0 end scoreSlope from scoreByN group by YearID, StudentDCID, StudentID, SectionsDCID, StandardID ), slopeNoExempt as( select StudentDCID , StudentID , SectionsDCID , StandardID , YearID , count(DueDate) scoreCount , case when count(DueDate) = sum(StandardExempt) then 0 -- if all scores are exempt, don't produce any slope when count(DueDate) > 1 then round(regr_slope(AssignmentScore, rNumber), 1) else 0 end scoreSlopeNoExempt from scoreByN where StandardExempt != 1 group by YearID, StudentDCID, StudentID, SectionsDCID, StandardID
)
select sa.StudentDCID StudentDCID , sa.StudentID StudentID , sa.SectionsDCID SectionsDCID , sa.StandardID StandardID , sa.YearID YearID , sa.scoreCount scoreCount , sa.exemptCount exemptCount , nvl(sne.scoreCount, 0) nonExemptCount , sa.scoreSlope scoreSlope , nvl(sne.scoreSlopeNoExempt, 0) scoreSlopeNoExempt from slopeAll sa left join slopeNoExempt sne on sa.studentdcid = sne.studentdcid and sa.sectionsdcid = sne.sectionsdcid and sa.standardid = sne.standardid and sa.yearid = sne.yearid order by 5,1,2,3,4

query.name: org.bps.sbgassign.standardgradesection.sbgscoreterms
query.description: Score trend by studentdcid, standardid, and sectiondcid
query.sql: select sgs.yearid , sgs.STUDENTSDCID , sgs.standardid , sgs.sectionsdcid , sgs.storecode , to_char(t.firstday, 'yyyy-mm-dd') StartDate , to_char(t.lastday, 'yyyy-mm-dd') EndDate from standardgradesection sgs inner join schools sc on sgs.SCHOOLSDCID=sc.DCID inner join terms t on sc.school_number = t.SCHOOLID and sgs.yearid = t.yearid and sgs.storecode = case when t.isyearrec=1 then 'Y1' else t.ABBREVIATION end inner join students s on sgs.STUDENTSDCID = s.dcid where s.id = :curstudid order by sgs.standardid, t.id
